confirmed_findings.detail: The source closes one display equation immediately before “If U” with no separating blank line, then closes the second immediately before the next “construction” and display equation. In the rendered tile, the prose joins the math as “).If U” and “constructionx_i”. Put the prose and each display on separate Markdown blocks.

The L2 citation title is shown as raw “kappa_p(A) = ||A||_p ||A^{-1}||_p” in the link block, rather than typeset math. The link block rendering itself is expected; the displayed reference title carries literal ASCII math.

The L1 reference block includes a title with the literal string “T^*T”; the caret and asterisk are printed as ordinary characters inside the linked title rather than as a superscript adjoint expression.
The citation title in the statement prints “kappa_p(A) = ||A||_p ||A^{-1}||_p” literally inside the link, exposing underscores, carets, and ASCII norm delimiters.
The L3 operator-norm citation title prints max_{||v||=1} ||Tv|| as ordinary ASCII with literal underscores and braces inside the link block.
